title: 大陆漂移与板块构造
lead: 岩石圈分裂为若七大板块，漂浮在软流层上缓慢移动——它们如何相互作用，塑造了山脉、海沟与地震带。
leadEn: The lithosphere is broken into a handful of plates riding the soft asthenosphere; how they interact builds mountains, trenches and earthquake belts.

points.v: 大陆轮廓拼合、同种化石与岩层跨洋分布、海底磁条带对称扩张。
points.vEn: Jigsaw coastlines, matching fossils and rock belts across oceans, and symmetric seafloor magnetic stripes.

points.v: 离散（张裂成洋中脊）、汇聚（俯冲造山或碰撞抬升）、转换（错动引发地震）。
points.vEn: Divergent (ridges), convergent (subduction or collision), and transform (strike-slip quakes).

points.v: 地幔对流与板块自身的重力拖拽（板拉力、脊推力）共同推动。
points.vEn: Mantle convection plus slab pull and ridge push move the plates.

points.v: 环太平洋火山地震带、喜马拉雅与阿尔卑斯的隆起都源于板块相互作用。
points.vEn: The Pacific Ring of Fire and the rise of the Himalaya and Alps stem from plate interactions.

sources.label: 魏格纳《海陆的起源》；板块构造综述
sources.labelEn: Wegener, The Origin of Continents and Oceans; plate tectonics syntheses

title: 地震与火山活动
lead: 地壳应力骤然释放成地震、岩浆上涌成火山——它们多沿板块边界成带分布，是地球内部能量的出口。
leadEn: Sudden stress release makes earthquakes, rising magma makes volcanoes—together they line the plate boundaries, venting Earth's internal energy.

points.v: 断裂起始处为震源，其地面投影为震中；纵波先至、横波破坏更大。
points.vEn: The rupture starts at the focus, its surface point the epicenter; P-waves arrive first, S-waves do more damage.

points.v: 震级衡量释放能量（对数关系），烈度衡量地面影响，两者不同。
points.vEn: Magnitude gauges released energy (logarithmic); intensity gauges ground effects—they differ.

points.v: 岩浆黏度与气体决定喷发方式：宁静溢流的盾状与猛烈的爆发式。
points.vEn: Magma viscosity and gas set the style: gentle effusive shields versus violent explosive eruptions.

points.v: 引发海啸、滑坡，却带来肥沃火山土与地热，人口常逆势聚集。
points.vEn: They spawn tsunamis and landslides yet bring fertile ash soils and geothermal energy, drawing people anyway.

sources.label: USGS 地震与火山监测资料

title: 岩石圈物质循环
lead: 岩浆岩、沉积岩、变质岩在内力与外力作用下相互转化，岩石圈没有终点、只有循环。
leadEn: Igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks recycle into one another through internal and surface forces—no end, only a cycle.

points.v: 岩浆冷却成岩浆岩，碎屑或化学沉淀成沉积岩，高温高压改造为变质岩。
points.vEn: Cooling magma forms igneous, settled or precipitated material forms sedimentary, heat and pressure metamorphose it.

points.v: 构造运动与岩浆供热、风化侵蚀搬运与沉积作用共同推动循环。
points.vEn: Tectonics and magma supply heat; weathering, erosion, transport and deposition drive the cycle.

points.v: 一次完整循环可跨越数千万年，地层因此成为地球历史的书页。
points.vEn: A full cycle can span tens of millions of years, making strata the pages of Earth's history.

points.v: 矿产、化石燃料与建材都在循环中富集，指向特定的成矿与成岩环境。
points.vEn: Ores, fossil fuels and building stone concentrate within the cycle, tied to specific ore- and rock-forming settings.

sources.label: 《地质学原理》岩石循环章节
sources.labelEn: Principles of Geology, the rock cycle

title: 气候的形成因子
lead: 太阳辐射打底，纬度、海陆、地形、洋流与大气环流共同调制，把一地长期的天气平均成气候。
leadEn: Solar radiation sets the base; latitude, land–sea, relief, currents and circulation tune it, averaging a place's weather into climate.

points.v: 太阳高度角随纬度递减，决定热量带从热带到寒带的分布。
points.vEn: The sun's angle falls with latitude, dividing heat zones from torrid to frigid.

points.v: 海洋升温慢降温慢，沿海气温年较差小、降水多，内陆更极端。
points.vEn: Ocean heats and cools slowly: coasts have smaller annual range and more rain, interiors are more extreme.

points.v: 海拔升高降温，迎风坡多地形雨、背风坡成雨影，垂直带谱由此而生。
points.vEn: Height cools the air, windward slopes catch orographic rain, leeward sides lie in rain shadow, giving vertical zonation.

points.v: 暖流增温增湿、寒流降温减湿，改变同纬度两岸的气候面貌。
points.vEn: Warm currents add heat and moisture, cold ones strip them, reshaping coasts at the same latitude.

sources.label: 斯特拉勒《自然地理体系》

title: 三圈环流与气压带风带
lead: 赤道受热上升、极地下沉，叠加地转偏向力，把全球自赤道到极地劈成一串气压带与风带。
leadEn: Air rises at the equator and sinks at the poles; spun by the Coriolis force, this carves a chain of pressure and wind belts from equator to pole.

points.v: 哈德莱、费雷尔与极地环流圈交替，构成低纬信风、中纬西风与极地东风。
points.vEn: Hadley, Ferrel and polar cells alternate, yielding trade, westerly and polar-easterly winds.

points.v: 赤道低压多雨、副热带高压干燥、副极地低压多锋面雨、极地高压干冷。
points.vEn: Equatorial low is wet, subtropical high is dry, subpolar low brings frontal rain, polar high is cold and dry.

points.v: 气压带风带随太阳直射点南北移动，驱动季风进退与干旱带摆动。
points.vEn: The belts migrate with the overhead sun, steering monsoon onset and the sway of dry zones.

points.v: 世界荒漠、草原与雨林的宏观格局，正是这些环流的地表投影。
points.vEn: The global mosaic of deserts, grasslands and rainforests is these cells written onto the map.

sources.label: 哈得来环流与行星风系经典模型
sources.labelEn: Hadley circulation and planetary wind system

title: 气团、锋面与天气系统
titleEn: Air Masses, Fronts and Weather Systems
lead: 大尺度天气由气团的性质与锋面、气旋的相遇决定，温带气旋是中纬度最常见的变天引擎。
leadEn: Synoptic weather hinges on air-mass character and on fronts and cyclones meeting; the mid-latitude cyclome is the region's chief change-maker.

points.v: 按源地的冷暖与干湿分类，气团属性决定其控制下的天气基调。
points.vEn: Classified by source temperature and moisture, an air mass sets the weather's baseline where it rules.

points.v: 冷锋陡急多对流、暖锋缓长多连续性降水，锢囚锋标志气旋成熟。
points.vEn: Cold fronts are steep and convective, warm fronts gentle and steady, occluded fronts mark a maturing cyclone.

points.v: 低压气旋辐合上升多阴雨，高压反气旋下沉辐散多晴朗。
points.vEn: Low pressure converges and rises into cloud and rain; high pressure subsides and spreads into clear skies.

points.v: 等压线疏密定风力、锋符号定移动，是现代预报的基石。
points.vEn: Isobar spacing sets wind speed and frontal symbols set motion—the foundation of modern forecasting.

sources.label: 挪威学派气旋模型与天气图
sources.labelEn: Norwegian cyclone model and synoptic charts

title: 水循环与水平衡
titleEn: The Water Cycle and Water Balance
lead: 蒸发、水汽输送、降水、径流与下渗把海洋、大气与陆地连成一个闭合循环，淡水在其中不断更新。
leadEn: Evaporation, transport, precipitation, runoff and infiltration link ocean, air and land into one closed loop that renews fresh water.

points.v: 海洋蒸发为主源，降水回陆，地表与地下径流再归海。
points.vEn: The ocean is the main source; rain falls on land, and surface and groundwater carry it back.

points.v: 太阳供热驱动蒸发与输送，重力牵引降水与径流下行。
points.vEn: Solar heat drives evaporation and transport, gravity pulls precipitation and runoff downward.

points.v: 取用水、修坝、砍伐与城市化改变径流与时空分布，加剧局部缺水。
points.vEn: Withdrawal, dams, deforestation and cities reshape runoff and its distribution, deepening local scarcity.

points.v: 降水与水资源在地区与季节上高度不均，决定农业与聚落格局。
points.vEn: Rainfall and water vary sharply by place and season, shaping farming and settlement.

sources.label: 联合国世界水发展报告

title: 洋流与温盐环流
titleEn: Ocean Currents and the Thermohaline Conveyor
lead: 风推动表层海流，冷暖与咸淡之差驱动深海缓慢环流，二者合成一台调节全球热量的传送带。
leadEn: Wind drives surface currents while differences in temperature and salinity power a slow deep loop—together a belt that shuttles heat around the planet.

points.v: 盛行风带动表层水，离岸处底层冷水上涌形成上升流，渔场多在此。
points.vEn: Prevailing winds drag surface water; offshore divergence draws cold upwelling that feeds great fisheries.

points.v: 高纬海水变冷变咸而下沉，深层缓慢回流，周期可达千年。
points.vEn: Polar water grows cold and salty and sinks, seeping back at depth over a cycle up to a millennium.

points.v: 洋流向高纬输热，使西欧比同纬度温暖，也影响全球气候分布。
points.vEn: Currents carry heat poleward, warming Europe beyond its latitude and shaping climate worldwide.

points.v: 融冰注入淡水可能削弱下沉与环流，牵动区域乃至全球气候突变。
points.vEn: Meltwater dilution may slow the sinking and the loop, tipping regional and even global climate.

sources.label: 温盐输送带与大洋环流研究
sources.labelEn: Thermohaline conveyor and ocean gyre research

title: 内外力作用与地貌演化
titleEn: Endogenic and Exogenic Forces in Landform Evolution
lead: 内力（构造与岩浆）搭建地表骨架、抬高地势，外力（风化侵蚀搬运堆积）削高填低，地貌是两者较量的产物。
leadEn: Inner forces (tectonics, magma) raise the frame while outer forces (weathering, erosion, transport, deposition) cut highs and fill lows—landforms are the tally of their contest.

points.v: 褶皱、断层与抬升形成山脉高原，决定宏观地势格架。
points.vEn: Folds, faults and uplift forge mountains and plateaus, setting the broad relief.

points.v: 流水、风、冰川与波浪按能量差异塑造谷、沙丘、峡湾与海蚀地貌。
points.vEn: Water, wind, ice and waves, keyed to energy, sculpt valleys, dunes, fjords and coastal erosional forms.

points.v: 戴维斯地貌循环描述从幼年壮年到老年阶段的起伏演化。
points.vEn: Davis's cycle traces relief from youthful through mature to old stages.

points.v: 地壳随负载升降，剥蚀与沉积触发均衡回弹，抬升与侵蚀相互反馈。
points.vEn: Crust rises and sinks with load; erosion and deposition trigger isostatic rebound, feedback between uplift and wear.

sources.label: 戴维斯地貌循环与均衡理论

title: 河流地貌与水系
lead: 一条河从源头到河口，上游下切、中游搬运、下游堆积，把地形写成从峡谷到三角洲的连续剧本。
leadEn: From source to mouth a river cuts upstream, carries through the middle and deposits downstream—a script from gorge to delta.

points.v: 上游以下蚀为主成 V 形谷，中下游以侧蚀与堆积成宽谷与河曲。
points.vEn: The upper reach cuts vertically into V-valleys; lower reaches widen and meander by lateral erosion and deposition.

points.v: 冲积扇、河漫滩、牛轭湖与三角洲记录能量骤变处的堆积。
points.vEn: Fans, floodplains, oxbow lakes and deltas mark deposition where energy drops.

points.v: 树枝状、平行状或放射状水系，反映岩性与构造格架。
points.vEn: Dendritic, parallel or radial networks mirror the rock and structure beneath.

points.v: 大河孕育农业与文明，堤坝、调水与渠化又重塑其泥沙与生态。
points.vEn: Great rivers cradled farming and civilization, while dams, diversions and channeling recast their sediment and ecology.

sources.label: 河流地貌学与水系分析

title: 自然带与地域分异规律
lead: 气候决定植被与土壤，地理环境因此沿纬度、经度与垂直方向分层，呈现有规律的整体更替。
leadEn: Climate steers vegetation and soils, so the landscape tiers along latitude, longitude and altitude in a law-governed whole.

points.v: 热量自赤道向两极递减，形成热带雨林到苔原的横向更替。
points.vEn: Heat falls from equator to pole, stepping rainforest through tundra.

points.v: 水分自沿海向内陆递减，出现森林—草原—荒漠的横向分异。
points.vEn: Moisture wanes inland, giving a forest–steppe–desert sequence.

points.v: 山地水热随高度变化，坡面像微缩的从赤道到极地。
points.vEn: Heat and water shift with height, so a slope reads as a mini equator-to-pole transect.

points.v: 气候、水文、土壤、生物相互耦合，牵一发而动全身。
points.vEn: Climate, water, soil and life are coupled—one change ripples through the whole.

sources.label: 道库恰耶夫自然带学说
